channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Economist Larry Summers to resign from Harvard after Epstein revelations
item.description: Lawrence H. Summers, a Harvard University economist and the school’s former president, will resign from teaching at the end of the academic year, according to a Harvard spokesperson.

item.title: Wellness influencer Casey Means poised to become nation’s top doctor
item.description: Dr. Casey Means appeared before a Senate committee today to make her case to become the next surgeon general. The job would make her the face of the mainstream medical system — which Means, a wellness influencer and entrepreneur, has vehemently criticized.

item.title: Yen hits 2-week low after pro-stimulus Bank of Japan picks
item.description: NEW YORK >> The yen reached a two-week low against the U.S. dollar today after Japan’s government appointed two academics who are viewed as strong advocates of economic stimulus to the central bank’s board, adding to concerns about the pace of further rate hikes.

item.title: Samsung unveils Galaxy S26; lifts prices in key markets amid chip price surge
item.description: SEOUL >> Samsung Electronics today launched its flagship Galaxy S26 smartphones with higher prices for some models in the United States and South Korea, testing demand as soaring memory chip costs pressure margins.

item.title: Cuba kills 4 aboard Florida-based speedboat in shootout
item.description: HAVANA >> Cuban forces killed four exiles and wounded six others who sailed into Cuban waters aboard a Florida-registered speedboat today and opened fire on a Cuban patrol, the Cuban government said at a time of heightened tensions with the United States.

item.title: Kash Patel reveals secret FBI subpoenas of his phone records
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The FBI subpoenaed records of phone calls made by Kash Patel and Susie Wiles, now the FBI director and White House Chief of Staff, when they were both private citizens in 2022 and 2023 during the federal probe of Donald Trump, Patel told Reuters today.

item.title: Teen indicted for attempted murder, firearm offenses in Kapolei shooting
item.description: An Oahu grand jury indicted a 19-year-old man for the Feb. 15 shooting of two government contractors in front of a Kapolei fast-food restaurant.

item.title: City announces additional on-leash parks on Oahu
item.description: City officials today announced the number of on-leash dog parks on Oahu has doubled after an initiative announced last year to improve access.

item.title: Swimmer, 28, rescued from waters at ‘Eternity Beach’
item.description: A man in his 20s is in serious condition after being pulled from waters off “Eternity Beach” in East Honolulu this afternoon, according to first responders.

item.title: SPJ Hawaii Chapter launches 2026 paid summer internships
item.description: The Hawaii chapter of the Society of Professional Journalists is accepting applications for its 2026 paid summer journalism internship program, offering students and recent graduates hands-on experience and on-the-job training in print, online and broadcast media.
